name: 3D product turntable
description: Three.js product shot on a transparent background: a podium rises, the product drops onto it and turns at a constant speed under a shadowed key light and two rim lights (one in the brand accent), with a glowing accent ring on the podium edge and a soft floor shadow. Built-in procedural products (a drinks can with your name on a canvas-drawn label, or a phone with a lit screen) or your own .glb via the model param; use for product reveals, e-commerce promos and launch videos (16:9 and 9:16).
